Management command to initialise permissions and reconcile existing users.

class news.management.commands.setup_roles.Command(stdout=None, stderr=None, no_color=False, force_color=False)[source]¶

Bases: BaseCommand

Refresh role permissions and reconcile all existing users.

Configure the groups first so each user is assigned to a group with the current permissions. Iterate over accounts without loading them all into memory, then report success.
